customer_question: Hi, we're on the Pro plan and I'm trying to invite a new analyst, but the Invite button says all seats are in use. There are 5 of us already. How do I add her without anyone losing their work? Thanks, Hannah
resolution: Pro includes 5 seats and all 5 were in use. Explained two options: remove a member who no longer needs access (Settings → Members in 3.x, Admin → Members in 4.x; their workflows stay in the workspace), or upgrade to Business, which includes 25 seats and applies immediately with prorated billing. The customer removed a former contractor and invited the new analyst.
